purpose: Trace each major experiment-design element to the unresolved evidence problem without promoting SQ10 analogues to TCD-016 physical truth.

design_rationale.reason: SQ10 found phase-specific rewetting plausibility for identified ammonium salts but no mapping from that chemistry to M_surface_NH4_non_aqueous_continuation.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Characterization of a tested residue does not automatically identify every ANIMO continuation state.

design_rationale.reason: The intrinsic rewetting behavior must first be separable from soil/mineral retention so that receiver ambiguity does not make the result uninterpretable.
design_rationale.claim_limit: An inert-surface result applies only to the tested residue and environment.

design_rationale.reason: SQ10 identified fixation/retention as a credible competing fate when mineral contact is plausible.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Observed soil retention cannot be generalized to untested matrices.

design_rationale.element: NH3 loss measurement or defensible bound
design_rationale.reason: SQ10 identified state-dependent atmospheric loss as a credible competing fate for ammoniacal N.
design_rationale.claim_limit: The literature does not prove that the TCD-016 dry continuation state volatilizes; the measurement is required to discriminate the possibility.

design_rationale.reason: A single terminal sample cannot distinguish immediate complete transfer from finite-rate or delayed release.
design_rationale.claim_limit: The earliest sample only defines experimental resolution, not metaphysical zero-time behavior.

design_rationale.element: full N mass closure with uncertainty
design_rationale.reason: Candidate discrimination is invalid if missing N can be hidden in unmeasured sinks or analytical error.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Mass closure validates accounting quality, not the physical process law by itself.

design_rationale.reason: Background N in Stage B can confound attribution of retained, aqueous and atmospheric N to the experimental source.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Tracer use is a design recommendation, not inherited ANIMO theory.

design_rationale.element: no universal replicate count or numerical epsilon
design_rationale.reason: SQ10/SQ09 provide no pilot variance, instrument performance or uncertainty model from which universal values could be scientifically justified.
design_rationale.claim_limit: Executing studies must predeclare their own power, uncertainty and acceptance criteria.
